2607.25667.title: MyMentorLLM: A psychotherapy GenAI environment with multimodal voice/text patients, trainees and experts for deliberate practice
2607.25667.paper_summary: Psychotherapists need repeated training and supervision by experts; however, scalability is problematic. Here we present MyMentorLLM, a multimodal voice- and text-based simulation environment for deliberate practice, used to generate 2,100 complete Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) training sessions. Each session links a DSM-5-TR-grounded patient (with major depressive, generalised anxiety or borderline personality disorder), a therapist-in-training and an expert supervisor. As an initial implementation, we adopted CBT because its structured procedures and competency-based supervision facilitate standardised simulation and evaluation. Sessions were analysed for emotional dynamics, therapeutic competence and diagnostic accuracy. Simulated patients expressed disorder-congruent emotional profiles, which trainee therapists mirrored as in real human counselling. The quality of supervision differed across LLMs: while most models overestimated trainees' competences, native speech-to-speech was closest to human scores. Supervisors' feedback led to better diagnoses in simulated psychotherapists in 5 out of 7 LLMs, and symptom identification accuracy increased with model size. This work shows that simulation of deliberate practice is possible for CBT training, although patient fidelity, calibration of supervisors, and harmful feedback should be evaluated together.
2607.25667.paper_summary_zh: 心理治療師需要專家反覆的訓練和監督；然而，擴展性是個問題。在這裡，我們呈現 MyMentorLLM，一個基於語音和文本的多模態模擬環境，用於有意識的練習，生成 2,100 次完整的認知行為療法 (CBT) 訓練課程。每次課程連結一位基於 DSM-5-TR 的患者（患有重度抑鬱、廣泛性焦慮或邊緣型人格障礙）、一位正在訓練的治療師和一位專家監督者。作為初步實施，我們選擇了 CBT，因為其結構化程序和基於能力的監督促進了標準化的模擬和評估。課程分析了情感動態、治療能力和診斷準確性。模擬患者表現出與其疾病相符的情感特徵，訓練中的治療師在真實的人類輔導中也反映了這一點。監督的質量在不同的 LLM 中有所不同：雖然大多數模型高估了訓練生的能力，但母語的語音轉語音最接近人類的評分。監督者的反饋使得模擬心理治療師在 7 個 LLM 中的 5 個得到了更好的診斷，而隨著模型大小的增加，症狀識別的準確性也有所提高。這項工作顯示出有意識的練習模擬對於 CBT 訓練是可能的，儘管患者的忠實度、監督者的校準和有害的反饋應該一起進行評估。
